verdict: Chicken shawarma is slightly better. A bit higher in calories, but more protein and less fat.
why: Shawarma is about 550 kcal, a stall chicken burger with egg about 500 kcal. Only a 50 kcal difference.
Shawarma has 30 g protein, the burger 22 g. 8 g more protein to keep you full longer.
Shawarma has 23 g fat, the burger 26 g. Stall burgers usually have lots of margarine and mayo.
Shawarma has some vegetables inside, so it feels more solid and you're less likely to add other food.
when_a: Shawarma is okay as a proper dinner, not a snack. Ask for less garlic sauce or mayo.
when_b: A stall chicken burger is okay once in a while when you're hungry at night. Ask for less sauce, less margarine and add vegetables.
tip: For both, ask for 'sos sikit je' (just a little sauce) and choose plain water or teh o kosong (no sugar). Lots of calories hide in the sauce.

faq.q: Is a burger without egg better?
faq.a: Egg actually adds protein. What's better to cut down is the mayo, sauce and margarine on the bun.

faq.q: Can I eat shawarma late at night?
faq.a: Yes. Meal timing matters less than your total calories for the day. Just make sure it replaces dinner, not something extra after dinner.
